  1. Not every round produces the same muzzle flash, or necessarily any flash at all
  2. Muzzle flashes often exist for less than one camera frame, meaning they sometimes don't get picked up by digital recording devices, even if a human eye would have seen them.
  3. Security cameras in particular are notorious for recording at low frame rates ( and while frame rate isn't the right word, they do a similar reduction to audio capture) - further exacerbating the issue in #2, especially for very short-lived events.
